name: Network Discovery
description: Scan your subnets and account for every device on them: Kea lease or reservation, the subnet's own gateway/DNS/Kea/Jen addresses, an IPAM Lite entry, a device Jen has seen, or one you marked known — only what's left is unknown, and only a new unknown alerts. Vendor from the MAC, scheduled scans, since-last-scan changes, one-click reservation or IPAM entry, CSV export. A new unknown host also reaches the Timeline, and the last-seen results are in Jen's global search. Needs nmap on the Jen host (Settings → Plugins can install it).
author: Matthew Thibodeau

ALTER TABLE nd_scan_results ADD COLUMN status VARCHAR(20) NULL AFTER rogue

name: IPAM Lite
description: Full IP address space management for Kea-managed AND unmanaged subnets, using everything Jen already knows: gateway, DNS and pool awareness (an address inside a DHCP pool is marked; infrastructure addresses are labelled, never "available"), a one-click next free address outside the pools, the devices table beside each lease, conflicts when a static address is taken by a DHCP client, per-address history, range operations, and Netbox/CSV import and export with a review step. Alerts on new conflicts, a JSON API for entries and next-free, and a global search provider. Replaces Netbox for simple static IP tracking.
author: Matthew Thibodeau

name: Host Watchdog
description: Probes chosen hosts on a schedule and alerts when one stops answering, and again when it comes back — the gap Network Discovery leaves, since it only alerts on a new unknown host appearing. Ping (unprivileged ICMP) or TCP connect, added from a Kea reservation, an IPAM Lite entry, or any IP. 7-day uptime, per-target history, a JSON API.
author: Matthew Thibodeau

db_migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wd_targets (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, ip VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL, mac VARCHAR(17) NULL, subnet_id INT NULL, label VARCHAR(100), source ENUM('reservation','ipam','manual') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', probe VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ping', interval_min INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, fails_to_down INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, enabled TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_by VARCHAR(100), created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wd_state (target_id INT PRIMARY KEY, state ENUM('up','down','unknown') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', since DATETIME NULL, last_ok_at DATETIME NULL, last_fail_at DATETIME NULL, consecutive_fails INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_error VARCHAR(200))

name: Local DNS Sync
description: Pushes DHCP names into Pi-hole or AdGuard Home local DNS so hostnames like nas.lan resolve without Kea DDNS — Jen only ever touches records it created itself (a ledger), and an Unbound export is offered for setups with no API.
author: Matthew Thibodeau

name: Switch Port Locator
description: Answers the one question Client Investigation can't: which switch port is this MAC on? Polls managed switches' MAC address tables over SNMP (BRIDGE-MIB / Q-BRIDGE-MIB) every 10 minutes, resolves the port name and alias (IF-MIB), and auto-detects uplinks by MAC count so trunk ports never look like where a device “lives”. Alerts when a known MAC's port changes.
author: Matthew Thibodeau

db_migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sp_switches (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, host VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, community TEXT, vlan_indexing ENUM('none','community') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', vlans VARCHAR(255) NULL, enabled TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, last_poll_at DATETIME NULL, last_error VARCHAR(300) NULL, created_by VARCHAR(100), created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sp_ports (switch_id INT NOT NULL, ifindex INT NOT NULL, ifname VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, ifalias VARCHAR(200) NULL, is_uplink TINYINT(1) NULL, PRIMARY KEY (switch_id, ifindex))
